explication: Violentmonkey is a WebExtension that installs, stores, updates, synchronizes, and runs userscripts in browser pages. The principal workflow is: a user installs or manages a script, extension background commands retrieve and persist it, injection coordinates execution, and content/web bridges expose userscript APIs. The sampled code directly supports command routing, installation parsing and fetching, cached storage, browser injection, and sync orchestration. Some subsystem links are inferred only at directory level because their implementations were not sampled.
